quarterly_data.quarter: Vanguard International Semiconductor IR presentation: MOPS 534720260804E001 (08-04-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: VIS Q2 2026 results deck: net revenue NT$14,245 million, up 13.7% QoQ and 21.8% YoY; gross margin 32.3% (1Q26 29.3%, 2Q25 28.0%); operating income NT$2,901 million (20.4%); net income attributable to the parent NT$2,975 million; diluted EPS NT$1.56. Total wafers shipped were 713 Kpcs (1Q26 642, 2Q25 627).
